content: I you, like me, can't really lean the printer on the backside because of stuff in the back (in my case advanced filtration and side INDX sensor mod for the left side), I found that instead of leaning the printer all the way back it also worked fine to only lift the front up enough to reach under there. For me, the foam parts that the INDX head was shipped in worked like a good stand to put under the front of the printer.
if you have HEPA filter no need for support box

If you have the 8 tool version, I recommend to add the top holders on the right side first. This does not have any impact for the screws below the base. The other way around, if you break your helper tool in this step, you'll miss it for the top right holders, for which it is required. These ones below can also be installed using the wrench.
